content:
name: EOSP WP-MVP-0004 Authorization Bootstrap

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - eosp/authorize-wp-mvp-0004-bootstrap

permissions:
  contents: write

jobs:
  authorize:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Enter exact active Work Cycle baseline
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          git fetch origin main
          test "$(git rev-parse origin/main)" = "b901cd852637e56f474e75b14dc2271d6867f04b"
          git checkout --detach b901cd852637e56f474e75b14dc2271d6867f04b
          git switch -c eosp/authorize-wp-mvp-0004
          git config user.name "ChatGPT"
          git config user.email "41898282+github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com"

      - name: Reconcile and adopt WP-MVP-0004
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          python3 - <<'PY'
          from pathlib import Path

          path = Path('engineering/work-packets/WP-MVP-0004.md')
          text = path.read_text(encoding='utf-8')
          old_status = '**Status:** Refined — blocked from Ready by WP-MVP-0003 and ADR-0005  '
          if old_status not in text:
              raise SystemExit('expected stale WP-MVP-0004 status line not found')
          text = text.replace(old_status, '**Status:** DRAFT  ', 1)
          if '- proposed ADR-0005' not in text:
              raise SystemExit('expected proposed ADR-0005 authority line not found')
          text = text.replace('- proposed ADR-0005', '- ADR-0005', 1)
          old_deps = 'WP-MVP-0003 provides stable source/document identity. ADR-0005 establishes implementation topology.'
          new_deps = ('- WP-MVP-0003 is CLOSED and provides stable source/document identity.\n'
                      '- ADR-0005 is Accepted and establishes the authorized MVP implementation topology.\n'
                      '- WC-MVP-0002 is ACTIVE and provides the current Parsing and Reference Resolution cycle context.')
          if old_deps not in text:
              raise SystemExit('expected stale dependency paragraph not found')
          text = text.replace(old_deps, new_deps, 1)
          path.write_text(text, encoding='utf-8')
          PY

          for p in \
            engineering/work-cycles/WC-MVP-0002.md \
            engineering/work-packets/WP-MVP-0003.md \
            architecture/decisions/ADR-0003-stable-source-and-document-identity.md \
            architecture/decisions/ADR-0004-safe-deterministic-ingestion-boundary.md \
            architecture/decisions/ADR-0005-mvp-core-implementation-topology.md \
            specifications/data/DATA-SOURCE-0001-stable-source-and-document-identity.md \
            specifications/technical/TECH-INGEST-0001-markdown-engineering-artifact-parsing.md; do
            test -f "$p"
          done

          cat > .eos/adoptions/wp-mvp-0004.json <<'EOF'
          {
            "schema_version": "1.0.0",
            "adoption_id": "ADOPT-WP-MVP-0004-2026-08-17",
            "reason": "Adopt WP-MVP-0004 after closure of WP-MVP-0003, activation of WC-MVP-0002, and acceptance of ADR-0005.",
            "evidence": [
              "engineering/work-cycles/WC-MVP-0002.md",
              "engineering/work-packets/WP-MVP-0003.md",
              "architecture/decisions/ADR-0003-stable-source-and-document-identity.md",
              "architecture/decisions/ADR-0004-safe-deterministic-ingestion-boundary.md",
              "architecture/decisions/ADR-0005-mvp-core-implementation-topology.md",
              "specifications/data/DATA-SOURCE-0001-stable-source-and-document-identity.md",
              "specifications/technical/TECH-INGEST-0001-markdown-engineering-artifact-parsing.md"
            ],
            "work_packets": [
              {
                "id": "WP-MVP-0004",
                "path": "engineering/work-packets/WP-MVP-0004.md",
                "title": "Markdown engineering artifact parser",
                "status": "DRAFT",
                "pi": "PI-MVP-001",
                "wc": "WC-MVP-0002",
                "domain": "CORE",
                "created": "2026-08-17T00:00:00Z",
                "updated": "2026-08-17T00:00:00Z",
                "github_url": ""
              }
            ]
          }
          EOF

          ./scripts/eos adopt .eos/adoptions/wp-mvp-0004.json --apply \
            --by 'Thomas Carter' \
            --reason 'Adopt WP-MVP-0004 after closure of WP-MVP-0003, activation of WC-MVP-0002, and acceptance of ADR-0005.'

      - name: Ready and authorize WP-MVP-0004
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          ./scripts/eos gate explain WP_READY WP-MVP-0004
          ./scripts/eos ready WP-MVP-0004 \
            --by 'Thomas Carter' \
            --reason 'WP-MVP-0004 prerequisites and governing contracts are satisfied under active WC-MVP-0002.'
          ./scripts/eos gate explain WP_AUTHORIZE WP-MVP-0004
          ./scripts/eos authorize WP-MVP-0004 \
            --by 'Thomas Carter' \
            --reason 'Explicit human authorization to proceed with WP-MVP-0004 Markdown engineering artifact parser under WC-MVP-0002.'

      - name: Refresh completed-packet evidence and synchronize
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          ./scripts/eos validate WP-MVP-0001 --profile wp
          ./scripts/eos validate WP-MVP-0002 --profile wp --execution EXEC-0004
          ./scripts/eos validate WP-MVP-0003 --profile wp --execution EXEC-0005
          ./scripts/eos verify --strict
          ./scripts/eos state status
          python3 scripts/sync-machine-docs.py --write
          python3 scripts/sync-machine-docs.py --check
          python3 - <<'PY'
          import csv
          from pathlib import Path

          def rows(path):
              with Path(path).open(newline='', encoding='utf-8') as f:
                  return list(csv.DictReader(f, delimiter='\t'))

          pi = {r['id']: r for r in rows('.eos/program-increments.tsv')}
          wc = {r['id']: r for r in rows('.eos/work-cycles.tsv')}
          wp = {r['id']: r for r in rows('.eos/work-packets.tsv')}
          assert pi['PI-MVP-001']['status'] == 'ACTIVE'
          assert wc['WC-MVP-0001']['status'] == 'CLOSED'
          assert wc['WC-MVP-0002']['status'] == 'ACTIVE'
          assert wp['WP-MVP-0001']['status'] == 'CLOSED'
          assert wp['WP-MVP-0002']['status'] == 'CLOSED'
          assert wp['WP-MVP-0003']['status'] == 'CLOSED'
          assert wp['WP-MVP-0004']['status'] == 'AUTHORIZED'
          text = Path('engineering/work-packets/WP-MVP-0004.md').read_text(encoding='utf-8')
          assert '**Status:** AUTHORIZED' in text
          assert 'proposed ADR-0005' not in text
          assert 'WP-MVP-0003 is CLOSED' in text
          assert 'WC-MVP-0002 is ACTIVE' in text
          PY

      - name: Commit authorization and prove stability
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          git add -A
          git commit -m 'chore(eosp): authorize WP-MVP-0004'
          ./scripts/eos verify --strict
          ./scripts/eos state status
          python3 scripts/sync-machine-docs.py --check
          test -z "$(git status --porcelain)"
          git push origin HEAD:refs/heads/eosp/authorize-wp-mvp-0004
